    Extending a cocycle across a minimal point #

    Let S be a path-convex set of objects of a chain-bounded ray category with cancellation and s ∈ S a point with no arrow into it from S. A cocycle on S \ {s} extends to a cocycle on S (exists_extend_min). The weights of the arrows out of s are a potential on the hyperforest whose hyperedges are the maximal nonzero morphisms out of s (with target in S), each containing the arrows below it; it is a hyperforest by chain-boundedness (eq_of_walkConn). This is the cocycle form of the injectivity H₁ A' → H₁ A in the proof of Bretscher–Gabriel 2.6 and Bongartz, A criterion for finite representation type, 2.2–2.3.
